title: Zeno and Anti-Zeno Effects in Dark-State Dynamics Under Thermal Dephasing: A Numerical Study
summary: The quantum Zeno and anti-Zeno effects describe how frequent measurements can either suppress or accelerate quantum dynamics. While extensively studied in various platforms, their manifestation in dark-state dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here we investigate the stability of dark states in a cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) system consisting of two atoms coupled to a single-mode cavity, subject to thermal dephasing that models continuous quantum non-demolition monitoring.
